sleeping_bag.name: LITE LINE 400
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight 2-3 season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Lite Line 400 is presented by Cumulus as the warmest model in its ultralight 2-2.5 season Lite Line series, built for fast-and-light mountain trips, forest bivy overnights and bikepacking from spring through fall.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 705 g total weight
- 400 g of 850 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 2 C / limit -4 C / extreme -20 C
- Pertex Quantum 29 g/m2 shell and liner
- 15D ripstop, DWR finish, 100% nylon
- Full-length 5 mm YKK zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- Anti-snag system and zipper garage
- Down-filled zip insulating tube
- 3D shaped hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Trapezoid chamber design
- Separately filled front and bottom
- Differential cut
- Inner zipped mesh pocket with noctilucent puller
- Stuffsack and storage sack included
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus positions the Lite Line 400 as its most versatile warm-weather ultralight option, reliable for chilly autumn camps without running too hot in midsummer.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Fast-and-light mountain trips, forest bivy overnights, bikepacking, spring to fall use.
